# Cobrief

> AI-powered proposal and contract software designed to help SMBs win deals faster with intelligent document generation and management.

Cobrief is a platform that combines AI-assisted editing with proposal, contract, and invoice generation capabilities. It enables small and medium-sized businesses to streamline their deal-closing process through automated document creation and collaboration features.

## Key Topics

- AI proposal software
- Contract management
- SMB tools
- Document collaboration
- Deal closing

- Invoice generation

- Document management
- Pricing

- AI assistant
